items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I did get to know Don Byas pretty well.

ctx.x: blood in their eye. Didn't make any difference. Every one of them, he blew 'em all out. Illinois Jacquet, Don Byas, Ben Webster, Willie Smith, Joe Thomas... Hawk never showed up. He never was in town. But everybody that showed up, he wound up blowin' 'em clear out of the place. And he was practically on his face before they even showed... He used to drink like crazy. He was already four feet off the ground when they showed up sober! Then he'd finish 'em off one by one. Never a bad word about 'em. They all put him…

So then I got my chance. One of the waitresses said that a guy wanted to talk me. And it was Benny's brother; and Benny wanted me. Then Jimmy Maxwell, the first trumpet player with Benny Goodman... Benny and Mel Powell had had a fight, and they were through. So Jimmy Maxwell was a good friend of Ben Webster's, and he talked to him about it, and he got me the job -- Ben told him to get me.
